sentences.text: The original agreement and the copy do not state the same pre-payment charge in clause 9.3: the original says 2% of the principal outstanding, while the copy says 3% of the principal outstanding. (E1, E5)
Both documents are in force and each states its own clause 9.3 charge in the loan agreement text and schedule of charges. (E1, E2, E3, E5, E11, E13)
